'''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide''' was a report written by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. The report included information on numerous weapons used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], including the [[Multi-Motion computer framework]] framework for real-time, three-dimensional computing developed by [[Holo3-Graphics]] and the [[MechBlaze Tracking Corp.|MechBlaze Tracking Corporation]] which created tracking devices. [[Deen Voorson]] owned a copy of it.
